protocol.heldOutPolicy: Independently authored by root after implementation freeze8472320, before scoring; implementation engineer does not see tasks or labels. Adversarial authored sample, not randomized production tasks. Single run retained without ranking edits.
protocol.substantive: Exact fact locator in source, matches, owners, nearbySymbols or source-bearing search snippet. A filename, import neighbor, warning or unrelated same-file symbol is not a hit.
protocol.groups: Any exact locator within one predeclared group counts once; owners, consumers and intentional-difference counterexamples have separate denominators.
protocol.ordinarySearch: Case-insensitive literal rg OR over task words, two context lines, first five matching files in sorted path order, same complete-response byte cap. This fixed scripted baseline is not an adaptive human/agent search session.
protocol.syntheticLimits: Public hand-authored retrieval fixture, not production scale or observed user incidents.
